summary: Full backend + frontend verification of BDesigner homepage content/hero/theme correction pass. Backend pytest 4/4 pass: GET /api/settings returns hero { total_duration:23, default_state:'construction', states:[construction@0/light, morning@19/light, night@22/dark] } each with icon+label; GET /api/projects?limit=8 returns 6 seeded portfolio projects each with id/title/cover/style/budget/views/shares; GET /api/homepage/sections construction_step returns exactly the approved 8 titles in order (Share Requirement, Get Pricing, Create Account, Team Assigned, Design & Review, Final Drawings + BOQ, Construction Proposal, Construction Execution) with old titles (Free Consultation, Site Visit, Quotation) fully removed. Frontend verified at 1440 and 390: 8 process-card-* rendered with the exact expected titles + descriptions; 6 project-card-* render in recent-projects-section at both viewports; three hero-mode-* buttons render and clicking them updates document.documentElement[data-theme] correctly (night->dark, morning->light, construction->light); light-mode toast on nav-how-it-works has bg rgb(255,255,255) + color rgb(17,17,17) (readable), dark-mode toast has bg rgb(21,21,21) + color rgb(245,245,245) (readable); mobile sticky CTA reads exactly 'Plan Your Dream Home' and opens registration-modal (visible). No pageerror/console errors during theme toggles; only pre-login /auth/me 401 probes as expected.

issues: Expected Start Date field uses browser default date picker (input[type=date] mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar component — minor consistency issue, out of scope of this pass

critical_code_review_comments: Hero timeline config is well-modeled in settings.hero — consider exposing an admin endpoint (PATCH /api/settings/hero) so ops can tune timestamps without a redeploy; migration in seed_homepage_defaults for construction_step is idempotent and safe.
Consider replacing native <input type='date'> in RegistrationModal with the existing shadcn Calendar + Popover for cross-browser consistency.
seed_data_creation: None manual — backend startup seed_portfolio_projects() already seeded 6 projects and construction_step migration force-updated the 8 approved titles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Default site theme is now 'light' at initial load because default_state=construction (theme=light). Night mode switches to dark. Hero video does NOT decode in headless Chromium (black frame) — DO NOT judge video seeking; verify buttons + data-theme attr instead. Preview URL supports ?nointro=1. Mobile sticky CTA data-testid=bd-sticky-cta-btn opens data-testid=registration-modal with title 'Plan Your Dream Home'. Toast styling controlled by .bd-theme-toast__toast in index.css. All 8 construction steps sourced from /api/homepage/sections construction_step.
